sentences.en: Overnight, Israel agreed to a ceasefire with the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah, a major

sentences.en: Today, a Times investigation into one controversial tactic, the Israeli use of Palestinian detainees as human shields, and what it reveals about the nature of the conflict.

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, November 27th.

sentences.en: You, Natan, have been investigating another practice by the Israeli military, one that's
sentences.zh: 而你，纳坦，一直在调查以色列军队的另一项做法，这一做法

sentences.en: unconnected to what happened in the court, but seems to also raise questions about the rules of war.

sentences.en: And that is Israel's use of Palestinians as human shields.

sentences.en: Tell me exactly what you found.

sentences.en: So, actually, I stumbled into this story.

sentences.zh: 大约在2024年1月，我在健身房灌水。

sentences.en: When I heard someone, who I quickly understood was an Israeli soldier who recently returned from
sentences.zh: 当时我听到一个人，我很快意识到他是一名刚从加沙回来的以色列士兵，

sentences.en: Gaza, talking about seeing Palestinians being sent into Hamas tunnels, that what he was
sentences.zh: 在谈论看到巴勒斯坦人被派往哈马斯地道，他所解释的是，

sentences.en: explaining, is that the military is using Palestinians as human shields, sending them into Hamas tunnels ahead of Israeli forces to probe those dangerous areas.
sentences.zh: 军方正在使用巴勒斯坦人作为人体盾牌，在以色列军队前方将他们派入哈马斯地道，以探查那些危险区域。

sentences.en: So, in other words, this is an Israeli soldier you're overhearing.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这是一个你无意中听到的以色列士兵。

sentences.en: The guy just came back from Gaza, and he's recounting how they used Palestinians as human shields in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这家伙刚从加沙回来，他在讲述他们在加沙是如何把巴勒斯坦人当作人体盾牌的。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And I admittedly wanted to know more.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我很想了解更多。

sentences.en: If true, if they were using Palestinians in this way in combat, this would be very, very wrong and illegal under both Israeli and international law.
sentences.zh: 如果属实，如果他们在战斗中以这种方式使用巴勒斯坦人，根据以色列法律和国际法，这将是非常非常错误且非法的。

sentences.en: So, I injected myself into the conversation, challenged him a bit to see how insistent he is, and he stood behind this story.
sentences.zh: 所以我插话加入了他们的谈话，稍微质疑了他一下，看看他有多坚持，而他坚持了这个说法。

sentences.en: And I went back home that day knowing that I have to get to the bottom of this to understand
sentences.zh: 那天我回到家，知道我必须打破砂锅问到底，以弄清楚

sentences.en: if this is something that only happens in one or two places and is very local, or is this something that is actually a widespread phenomenon across the military?
sentences.zh: 这究竟是只发生在一两处非常局部的现象，还是军队中普遍存在的普遍现象？

sentences.zh: 那你接下来做了什么？

sentences.zh: 嗯，当时我只有一个线索，对吧？

sentences.en: I was able to get his number, and I called him up a few days later.
sentences.zh: 我设法拿到了他的电话号码，几天后我给他打了电话。

sentences.en: I introduced myself as a journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 我自我介绍说是一名记者。

sentences.en: I said that I'm interested to hearing more of his thoughts about how the war is being fought, and when we got to this topic again, he shared a few more details, telling me more
sentences.zh: 我说我有兴趣听听他对这场战争打法更多的想法，当我们再次谈到这个话题时，他分享了更多细节，多多少少

sentences.en: or less where it took place.
sentences.zh: 告诉我这件事发生在哪里。

sentences.en: But at some point, he closed in and said that he'd want to stop the conversation there.
sentences.zh: 但在某个时候，他打住了，说他想把谈话就在这里停下。

sentences.en: He said that he's not very willing to talk about this anymore.
sentences.zh: 他说他不太愿意再谈这个了。

sentences.en: So, basically, he went dark before you could actually understand exactly what this phenomenon was.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，在你真正弄清楚这到底是什么现象之前，他就失联了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we had a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多疑问。

sentences.en: We wanted to know how widespread it is.
sentences.zh: 我们想知道这有多普遍。

sentences.en: Who are those Palestinians?
sentences.zh: 那些巴勒斯坦人是谁？

sentences.en: And mainly, who authorized this?
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，是谁授权的？

sentences.en: And slowly, slowly, we were able to find more people.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，我们找到了更多人。

sentences.en: Some of them came forward because they thought that it's very disturbing.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人主动站出来，因为他们认为这非常令人不安。

sentences.en: Others, we just kept on asking those questions.
sentences.zh: 另一些人，我们则继续追问那些问题。

sentences.en: And we were able to piece together a full picture.

sentences.en: And what did that picture show?

sentences.en: So, over a course of about 10 months of investigation, we, Bilal Shabir, my colleague in Gaza, and Patrick
sentences.zh: 在长达约10个月的调查中，我们——我在加沙的同事比拉尔·沙比尔，以及

sentences.en: Kingley, the Jerusalem Bureau Chief of the New York Times, were able to uncover a disturbing practice of the Israeli military in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》耶路撒冷分社长帕特里克·金利——揭露了以色列军队在加沙令人不安的做法。

sentences.en: And they sent them ahead of forces into homes that they were afraid were booby-trapped by
sentences.zh: 他们把巴勒斯坦人派到部队前面，进入他们担心被哈马斯

sentences.en: Hamas.
sentences.zh: 布下诡雷的房屋。

sentences.en: In some cases, Palestinian detainees were dressed as IDF soldiers, and in others, they were given body cameras to take with them to give live feed to Israeli soldiers.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，巴勒斯坦被扣押人员被穿上以色列国防军士兵的制服，而在其他情况下，他们被发给随身摄像机，以便向以色列士兵提供实时画面。

sentences.en: Why use Palestinians for this?
sentences.zh: 为什么要为此使用巴勒斯坦人？

sentences.en: Why do this at all, for that matter?
sentences.zh: 从这方面来说，为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: You know, Israel has an incredibly sophisticated military and presumably the technology to do this kind of work.
sentences.zh: 你知道，以色列拥有极其先进的军队，理应具备完成这种工作的技术。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: So, there are different reasons.
sentences.zh: 所以，原因有多种。

sentences.en: So, first off, as great as drones and robots and even canine dogs can probe tunnels, a human being that can walk and move objects is way more efficient in probing areas.
sentences.zh: 首先，尽管无人机、机器人甚至军犬都可以探查地道，但一个能够行走和移动物体的活人，在探查区域方面要高效得多。

sentences.en: Sometimes, a person can do tasks that a drone and a robot can't really do.
sentences.zh: 有时候，人能够完成无人机和机器人无法真正完成的任务。

sentences.en: And the other thing is that after three months of war, a canine dog is not as efficient as it was in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 另一个原因是，经过三个月的战争，军犬已不如过去那么高效了。

sentences.en: They're too traumatized and they're confused from all the smell of the explosives around.
sentences.zh: 周围所有爆炸物的气味让它们受到过度创伤并感到困惑。

sentences.en: So, they lose their orientation.
sentences.zh: 因此它们失去了方向感。

sentences.en: So, whenever sniffer dogs, robots, or drones weren't good enough to probe the tunnels or walk ahead of forces into homes, they started using Palestinian prisoners as human shields
sentences.zh: 所以，每当搜爆犬、机器人或无人机不足以探查地道或走在部队前面进入房屋时，他们就开始使用巴勒斯坦囚犯作为人体盾牌

sentences.en: for dangerous tasks.
sentences.zh: 来执行危险任务。

sentences.en: So, the Israeli military is using people, Palestinian detainees, to do this very dangerous job that even dogs at this point can't do.
sentences.zh: 所以以色列军队正在使用人类——巴勒斯坦被扣押人员——来做这项连狗在此时都无法完成的极其危险的工作。

sentences.en: Were you able to talk to anyone who this actually happened to?
sentences.zh: 你们有机会和真正遭遇过这种事的人交谈吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, our reporter in Gaza, Bilal Shabir, spoke with three Palestinians who spoke on the record about their experience as being used as human shields.
sentences.zh: 我们在加沙的记者比拉尔·沙比尔与三名巴勒斯坦人进行了交谈，他们公开记录了自己被当作人体盾牌的经历。

sentences.en: One of them was a pharmacist named Bashir el-Dalu.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是一位名叫巴希尔·阿尔达鲁的药剂师。

sentences.en: He's a 43-year-old father of four from northern Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他是来自加沙北部的一名43岁父亲，有四个孩子。

sentences.en: In the beginning of the war, he and his family fled south.
sentences.zh: 战争刚开始时，他和家人逃往南方。

sentences.en: And then, around mid-November, he decided that he wants to make a risky trip back to his home to get some essentials, some things that his family really needed.
sentences.zh: 然后在大约11月中旬，他决定冒险回一趟家，去拿一些生活必需品，也就是他家人真正需要的物品。

sentences.en: At that point, the Israeli military considered any Palestinian walking around these unpopulated areas as a potential Hamas operative.
sentences.zh: 当时，以色列军队将任何在这些无人居住地区四处游荡的巴勒斯坦人都视为潜在的哈马斯特工。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: Because this was after the Israelis had told everybody to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 因为这是在以色列人已经通知所有人撤离之后。

sentences.en: So, anybody still there was suspect.
sentences.zh: 所以任何留在那儿的人都是可疑的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, after Bashir got to his home, the Israeli military detained him.
sentences.zh: 所以在巴希尔到家后，以色列军队扣留了他。

sentences.en: And by his account, they ordered him at gunpoint to undress, and they blindfolded him.
sentences.zh: 据他讲述，他们用枪指着命令他脱光衣服，并蒙上了他的眼睛。

sentences.en: Then, they took him barefoot and almost completely naked to a nearby yard of a multi-story building.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们把他光着脚、几乎赤身裸体地带到附近一栋多层建筑的庭院里。

sentences.en: And then, they took off the blindfold, made sure that his hands are tied in front of him and not in the back so he'd be able to move objects, and told him to go ahead of forces
sentences.zh: 接着，他们解开眼罩，确保他的双手被绑在身前而不是身后，这样他就能移动物体，并命令他走在部队前面

sentences.en: and probe that area.
sentences.zh: 去探查那个区域。

sentences.en: And this yard, according to his account, was partly ruined.
sentences.zh: 根据他的叙述，这个院子已经部分损毁。

sentences.en: There were glass all over the floor, and as he was walking, he was injured by this glass.
sentences.zh: 地上到处都是玻璃，当他走路时，他被这些玻璃割伤了。

sentences.en: Because his feet were bare.
sentences.zh: 因为他光着脚。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: His feet were bare.
sentences.zh: 他光着脚。

sentences.en: And the soldiers were staying behind, giving him directions from a megaphone.
sentences.zh: 士兵们则留在后面，用扩音器给他指路。

sentences.en: So, they ordered him to move around the yard, looking into different places, places they thought were potentially booby-trapped, or an entrance to a tunnel.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们命令他在院子里四处走动，查看不同的地方，即他们认为可能布有诡雷或通往地道入口的地方。

sentences.en: And then, there was noise coming out from around an electricity generator.
sentences.zh: 然后，一个发电机附近传出了噪音。

sentences.en: And the soldiers got really afraid, and started shooting in that direction.
sentences.zh: 士兵们变得非常害怕，开始朝那个方向开枪。

sentences.en: But it turned out that it was a kitten that made all this noise.
sentences.zh: 但结果证明，制造出所有这些噪音的只是一只小猫。

sentences.en: And he said that some of the soldiers laughed in relief.
sentences.zh: 他说一些士兵如释重负地笑了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Was he hurt?
sentences.zh: 他受伤了吗？

sentences.en: He wasn't hurt from the shooting, but he was injured from walking barefoot on the glass.
sentences.zh: 他没有被枪击受伤，但赤脚走在玻璃上受了伤。

sentences.en: So, they used him as a human shield in several instances, but eventually, they decided to take him into Israel and send him to an Israeli detention center.
sentences.zh: 所以他们多次把他当作人体盾牌，但最终，他们决定把他带到以色列，并送进以色列的一个拘留中心。

sentences.en: And I think that one of the things that really sent chills into my arms when I heard this story
sentences.zh: 我想，当我听到这个故事时，真正让我浑身起鸡皮疙瘩的事情之一是，

sentences.en: is that he said that he was excited, happy, and relieved to get there, knowing that he's outside of this dangerous zone.
sentences.zh: 他说当他到达那里时，他感到兴奋、高兴和如释重负，因为他知道自己已经离开了这个危险区域。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, that actually shows you how frightening that was for him, that he felt better once he got to the
sentences.zh: 所以这实际上向你展示了这对他是多么可怕，以至于一旦他进入以色列拘留中心，他就会感觉好一些，这通常不是加沙人往往会觉得很有安全感的地方。

sentences.en: Israeli detention center, not generally the kind of place that a Gazan would tend to feel very safe in.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得同样重要的是要提到，他在那里得到了伤病治疗，

sentences.en: And I think that it's also important to mention that he was treated there for his injuries,
sentences.zh: 但随后不久就被释放并送回了加沙，这告诉我们以色列情报部门并不认为他与任何武装组织有牵连。

sentences.en: but also released later on, sent back to Gaza, which tells us that the Israeli intelligence did not think that he was involved with any militant group.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 他本质上只是一个平民。

sentences.en: That he was essentially just a civilian.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我们后来发现，阿尔达鲁的经历并不是个例。

sentences.en: And what we later found out is that El Dalo's experience wasn't that rare.
sentences.zh: 在整场战争中，以色列军队一次又一次地使用巴勒斯坦人作为人体盾牌。

sentences.en: The Israeli military used Palestinians as human shields again and again throughout the war.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我编写了游戏《连连看》（Connections），这是《纽约时报》游戏中的一个拼图，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚刚听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.zh: 纳坦，你说过你最终了解到药剂师巴希尔的故事其实并非个例。

sentences.en: So, Natan, you said that you eventually came to understand that the story of Bashir, the pharmacist, was actually not that rare.
sentences.zh: 但其实际范围究竟有多大？

sentences.en: But what was the actual scope of this?
sentences.zh: 规模是怎样的？

sentences.en: What was the scale?
sentences.zh: 很难准确了解规模，但我们与16名以色列国防官员和士兵进行了交谈。

sentences.en: So, it's very difficult to understand the scale, but we spoke to 16 Israeli defense officials and soldiers.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人参与了这种做法，大多数人将其描述为一种相当常规的做法。

sentences.en: Some of them participated in this practice, and most of them described it as a rather routine practice.
sentences.zh: 在我们看来，这种做法在整场战争中变得越来越普遍。

sentences.en: And it seemed to us that this practice became more and more widespread throughout the war.
sentences.zh: 让我们明白这一点的原因之一是，我们在比如4月或3月找了一些人，问他们是否知道任何相关情况。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons that made us understand that is that we went to some people in, say, April or March, and asked them if they know anything about it.
sentences.zh: 他们斩钉截铁地回答了不。

sentences.en: And they gave us a hard no.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你知道，这根本不是他们能想象人们会做的事。

sentences.en: They said, you know, this is not something that they would imagine people would be doing.
sentences.zh: 但当我们到6月或7月再次回访时，他们突然说他们碰巧遇到了，甚至亲眼目睹了。

sentences.en: But then again, when we circle back in June or July, suddenly they said that they came across it and even saw it with their own eyes.
sentences.zh: 所以随着战争的进行，这种做法似乎变得更加普遍了。

sentences.en: So, the practice seemed to have gotten much more widespread as the war went on.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: Exactly, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 我们已经能够证实，加沙地带至少有11个不同的分队发生了这种情况。

sentences.en: And we were able to confirm that this took place in at least 11 different squads throughout the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 我们已经能够证实，加沙地带至少有11个不同的分队发生了这种情况。

sentences.en: So, from the north to the south in five Palestinian cities.
sentences.zh: 所以，从北部到南部，在五个巴勒斯坦城市。ан

sentences.en: And what really gave us a clear idea that this is quite commonplace practice was that it had a term.
sentences.zh: 真正让我们清楚地意识到这种做法相当普遍的原因是，它有一个专门的术语。

sentences.en: So, the practice was broad enough throughout the military that it had a name and, you know, people knew it.
sentences.zh: 所以，这种做法在整个军队中非常普遍，以至于它有一个名字，而且你知道，大家都知道。

sentences.en: That implies scope.
sentences.zh: 这意味着它的范围很广。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, the first time we heard these terms was in February.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们第一次听到这些词是在二月。

sentences.en: A soldier who came back from the battlefields told us that already in November, he heard a senior commander explain to his deputy
sentences.zh: 一个从战场回来的士兵告诉我们，早在十一月，他就听到一位高级指挥官向他的副手解释

sentences.en: that a nearby unit is asking for either a mosquito or a wasp.
sentences.zh: 附近的一个部队正在索要“蚊子”或“黄蜂”。

sentences.en: And what does he mean there?
sentences.zh: 他这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: I mean, mosquito and wasp.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，“蚊子”和“黄蜂”。

sentences.en: So, luckily for us, the deputy didn't know either.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，副手也不知道。

sentences.en: And the more senior commander explained to him that a mosquito is a Palestinian who was detained nearby in Gaza and was then being used as a human shield
sentences.zh: 这位高级指挥官向他解释说，“蚊子”是一个在加沙附近被扣押、随后被用作人肉盾牌的巴勒斯坦人，

sentences.en: in tunnels or in other dangerous places.
sentences.zh: 被用在隧道或其他危险的地方。

sentences.en: As for wasps, we got varying accounts from sources.
sentences.zh: 至于“黄蜂”，我们从不同消息来源得到了不同的说法。

sentences.en: What we do know is that a wasp is someone who was in Israel and was brought into Gaza by Israeli intelligence officers for brief and specific missions.
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道的是，“黄蜂”是指那些曾在以色列、被以色列情报官员带入加沙执行简短特定任务的人。

sentences.en: And there was some disagreement about whether these were detainees or whether these were paid collaborators who volunteered to enter Gaza with the military.
sentences.zh: 对于这些人究竟是被扣押人员，还是自愿随军进入加沙的有偿合作者，各方存在一些分歧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, in other words, mosquitoes are kind of like Bashir, the pharmaciSt.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，“蚊子”有点像巴希尔，那个药剂师。

sentences.en: They maybe got swept up in something inside Gaza, but wasps were different.
sentences.zh: 他们可能是在加沙内部被卷入某些事情的，但“黄蜂”则不同。

sentences.en: They were brought from Israel back to Gaza and used there.
sentences.zh: 他们是从以色列被带回加沙并在那里被使用的。

sentences.en: But why would that happen?
sentences.zh: 但这怎么会发生呢？

sentences.en: And what is the purpose of moving them?
sentences.zh: 转移他们的目的是什么？

sentences.en: It seems quite complicated to do.
sentences.zh: 这样做似乎相当复杂。

sentences.en: So, what I understood from several of the soldiers is that these are sometimes Palestinians who have knowledge of the tunnels or other places.
sentences.zh: 据我从几位士兵那里了解到的，这些人有时是对隧道或其他地方有所了解的巴勒斯坦人。

sentences.en: Sometimes they were being used as human shields going into those tunnels ahead of the forces.
sentences.zh: 有时他们被用作人肉盾牌，在部队前方进入这些隧道。

sentences.en: But they were also used for intelligence and sometimes to point to places where they told the Israeli military could potentially be makeshift graves of hostages.
sentences.zh: 但他们也被用于情报搜集，有时用来指出他们告诉以色列军方可能是人质临时墓地的地方。

sentences.en: So, places that Hamas have hidden the bodies of Israeli soldiers taken captive on October 7th.
sentences.zh: 也就是哈马斯藏匿10月7日被俘以色列士兵遗体的地方。

sentences.en: So, in other words, they might have some specific knowledge of where to look and where to find things.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们可能对去哪里寻找以及在哪里找到东西有一些具体的了解。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Israeli military was hoping to squeeze as much information as they could from those people.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方希望从这些人身上榨取尽可能多的信息。

sentences.en: But the flip side of it is that it also created a lot of paperwork and bureaucracy and required logistics and coordination by different units and different agencies as well.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，这也带来了大量的文书工作和官僚作风，需要不同单位和不同机构的后勤保障与协调。

sentences.en: This suggests that senior commanders did not only know about it, but sanctioned at least several versions of this tactic.
sentences.zh: 这表明高级指挥官不仅知道这件事，而且批准了这种战术的至少几个版本。

sentences.en: And what did the Israeli military say to you when you confronted them about the practice before you published your article?
sentences.zh: 在你发表文章之前，当你向以色列军方对质这种做法时，他们对你说了什么？

sentences.en: The Israeli military did not deny this.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方并没有否认这一点。

sentences.en: They said in the statement that its directives and guidelines strictly prohibit the use of detained Gaza civilians for military operations.
sentences.zh: 他们在声明中表示，其指令和准则严格禁止在军事行动中使用被扣押的加沙平民。

sentences.en: It added that the account of the Palestinian detainees and soldiers interviewed by the Times would be examined by the relevant authorities.
sentences.zh: 声明还称，相关部门将对《泰晤士报》采访的巴勒斯坦被扣押人员和士兵的说法进行审查。

sentences.en: So, they said they'd look into it.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们说会调查此事。

sentences.en: What exactly are the laws and conventions around this?
sentences.zh: 围绕这方面的法律和公约究竟是什么？

sentences.en: So, using civilians or militants as human shields in a battlefield is completely illegal, not only by international law, but also by Israeli law.
sentences.zh: 在战场上使用平民或武装人员作为人肉盾牌是完全非法的，不仅违反国际法，也违反以色列法律。

sentences.en: And Israel has some experience with that.
sentences.zh: 以色列在这方面有一些经验。

sentences.en: About two and a half decades ago, the Israeli military used Palestinian civilians for risky missions, mostly in the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 大约二十五年前，以色列军方曾将巴勒斯坦平民用于危险任务，主要是在约旦河西岸。

sentences.en: And this went to court.
sentences.zh: 这闹上了法庭。

sentences.en: And the Israeli Supreme Court said that this is completely prohibited under Israeli law and ordered the military to stop with this practice.
sentences.zh: 以色列最高法院裁定，根据以色列法律，这是绝对禁止的，并命令军方停止这种做法。

sentences.en: But you've shown here that they're doing it again.
sentences.zh: 但你在这里展示了他们又在这样做了。

sentences.en: What happened after your story published?
sentences.zh: 你的报道发表后发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, we know that it was discussed in the military and the government, but we can't really tell you if the military took serious steps in order to prevent it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道军队和政府内部讨论过此事，但我们无法真正告诉你军方是否采取了严肃的措施来防止这种行为。

sentences.en: But it's also important to note that the intensity of the war in Gaza went down significantly in the past few months.
sentences.zh: 但同样重要的是要注意到，在过去的几个月里，加沙战争的激烈程度已经显著下降。

sentences.en: And it's possible that this practice isn't as widespread as it was in the height of the war.
sentences.zh: 这种做法可能不像战争最高峰时那样普遍。

sentences.en: But as far as I know, not one Israeli officer or conscript was punished or even investigated for participating in this practice.
sentences.zh: 但据我所知，没有一名以色列军官或义务兵因为参与这种做法而受到惩罚，甚至没有受到调查。

sentences.en: Natan, I'm curious about those Israeli soldiers that you talked to and how they saw this practice.
sentences.zh: 纳坦，我很好奇你交谈过的那些以色列士兵，他们是如何看待这种做法的？

sentences.en: I mean, fundamentally, it was something that was meant to protect them, of course.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从根本上说，这当然是为了保护他们。

sentences.en: But clearly, some of them must have felt uncomfortable with it because they were talking to you, a journalist, about it.
sentences.zh: 但显然，他们当中有些人一定对此感到不安，因为他们正在向你这个记者谈论这件事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We wouldn't be able to report on this story if it wasn't for the many Israeli soldiers who felt
sentences.zh: 要不是许多以色列士兵感到

sentences.en: disgust and disturbed and horrified by the fact that the Israeli military is using this practice.
sentences.zh: 对以色列军方采用这种做法感到厌恶、不安和惊恐，我们根本无法报道这个故事。

sentences.en: One soldier told us that his entire platoon pushed back so hard that they basically stopped using this
sentences.zh: 一名士兵告诉我们，他的整个排进行了强烈的抗拒，以至于他们基本上停止了

sentences.en: practice in their platoon, releasing the two Palestinian civilians who they were using as human shields.
sentences.zh: 在其排里使用这种做法，并释放了他们一直在用作人肉盾牌的两名巴勒斯坦平民。

sentences.en: And I think that one thing that really resonated with me is that a soldier said that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想有一件事真正引起了我的共鸣，那就是一名士兵说，你知道的，

sentences.en: even if this war is justified, it doesn't mean that everything we do or everything that we can do in this war is justified.
sentences.zh: 即使这场战争是正义的，并不意味着我们在战争中所做的一切或我们能够做的一切都是正义的。

sentences.en: Natan, at a high level, it seems like what you're reporting shows, and correct me if I'm wrong here,
sentences.zh: 纳坦，从宏观层面来看，你的报道似乎显示，如果我错了请纠正我，

sentences.en: is that the Israeli military, like Hamas, is willing to sacrifice Palestinian civilians for their own military purposes.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方和哈马斯一样，为了自身的军事目的愿意牺牲巴勒斯坦平民。

sentences.en: And Israel, of course, accuses Hamas of hiding within civilian populations, essentially using
sentences.zh: 当然，以色列指责哈马斯藏匿在平民之中，实质上是在加沙

sentences.en: Palestinians as human shields in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 把巴勒斯坦人当作人肉盾牌。

sentences.en: And now we know that Israel is also using Palestinians as human shields.
sentences.zh: 现在我们知道以色列也在把巴勒斯坦人当作人肉盾牌。

sentences.en: So I'm wondering if you think that the correct way to understand your reporting here is actually
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道，你认为理解你这篇报道的正确方式实际上是否

sentences.en: a sort of shared disregard, both on the part of the Israeli military and Hamas, for Palestinian civilian life.
sentences.zh: 是以色列军方和哈马斯双方对巴勒斯坦平民生命的一种共同冷漠。

sentences.en: Well, there is a common thread in the disregard to Palestinian lives, and both are terribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在对巴勒斯坦生命的冷漠上确实存在一个共同点，这两者都是极其错误的。

sentences.en: But they're each going about it in their own way.
sentences.zh: 但他们各自以自己的方式行事。

sentences.en: Hamas is a terrorist organization that is showing disregard for its own people, whereas Israel is a sovereign state that is violating the rules of war.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯是一个对本国人民表现出冷漠的恐怖组织，而以色列是一个违反战争规则的主权国家。

sentences.en: And I think that an important takeaway from this story is how the Israeli military, which is a
sentences.zh: 我认为这个故事的一个重要启示是，以色列军方——作为一个联合国成员国、拥有世界上

sentences.en: military of a state that is a member of the UN, that has, you know, the most powerful nations in the world
sentences.zh: 最强大国家作为盟友的国家的军队，

sentences.en: as allies, has its military standards being deteriorating to a place that it haven't been ever before, namely using Palestinians as human shields in this widespread way.
sentences.zh: 其军事标准已经恶化到了前所未有的地步，即以这种广泛的方式将巴勒斯坦人当作人肉盾牌。

sentences.en: And one way to understand how it could have deteriorated to this point is to be reminded of the shock of Israeli society after seeing the October 7 atrocities.
sentences.zh: 理解它如何恶化到这种地步的一个方法是回想起以色列社会在看到10月7日暴行后的震惊。

sentences.en: And the Israeli society was just traumatized by this,
sentences.zh: 以色列社会对此感到极度创伤，

sentences.en: which clouded the moral judgment of many Israeli soldiers walking into their roles in the military and later marching into Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这模糊了许多以色列士兵进入军队岗位、后来开进加沙时的道德判断。

sentences.en: In other words, there's an emotional response that's happening on the part of Israelis and Israeli citizens who, of course, are also Israeli soldiers.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，以色列人以及作为以色列士兵的以色列公民产生了一种情绪反应。

sentences.en: And that is clouding, in some ways, judgment and allowing them or perhaps kind of inviting them to see Palestinians in this dehumanized way.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这模糊了判断，允许或者说促使他们以这种非人化的方式看待巴勒斯坦人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And also made them think that Hamas are Palestinians and that Palestinians are Hamas, which is something that is a bit hard for the greater Israeli society to understand,
sentences.zh: 这也让他们认为哈马斯就是巴勒斯坦人，巴勒斯坦人就是哈马斯，这一点对于更广泛的以色列社会来说有点难以理解，

sentences.en: that there are many Palestinians who oppose Hamas or many Palestinians who are suffering from Hamas and who suffered from Hamas even from before the war.
sentences.zh: 即有许多巴勒斯坦人反对哈马斯，或者许多巴勒斯坦人正在遭受哈马斯的折磨，甚至在战前就饱受哈马斯之苦。

sentences.en: But this shows a deterioration in the regards to human lives by the Israeli military and something that we've never seen before.
sentences.zh: 但这表明以色列军方对人命的蔑视已经恶化到了我们从未见过的地步。

sentences.en: Where, then, does Israel go from here?
sentences.zh: 那么，以色列接下来该何去何从？

sentences.en: So we're in the stage of the war in which the intensity of the fighting is winding down in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 我们现在处于加沙战斗激烈程度正在减弱的战争阶段。

sentences.en: And also, the ICC have just issued the orders against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Minister of Defense Yoav Gallant.
sentences.zh: 此外，国际刑事法院刚刚对总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡和前国防部长约亚夫·加兰特发出了逮捕令。

sentences.en: So these two things make it harder for Israelis to ignore the consequences of the war in Gaza,
sentences.zh: 因此，这两件事使得以色列人更难忽视加沙战争的后果，

sentences.en: namely, the vast destruction and the many tens of thousands of Palestinians who died in this conflict.
sentences.zh: 也就是巨大的破坏以及在这场冲突中死去的数万名巴勒斯坦人。

sentences.en: And now Israeli society that has justified this war throughout needs to face unjustified parts of it,
sentences.zh: 现在，一直为这场战争辩护的以色列社会需要直面其中不义的部分，

sentences.en: like in the case that Bilal, Patrick, and I uncovered about how it's using Palestinians as human shields.
sentences.zh: 就像比拉尔、帕特里克和我所揭露的关于它如何将巴勒斯坦人当作人肉盾牌的案例一样。

sentences.en: Natan, thank you.
sentences.zh: 纳坦，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: Early this morning, the ceasefire between Israel and the Lebanese militia group Hezbollah went into effect.
sentences.zh: 今天清晨，以色列与黎巴嫩民兵组织真主党的停火协议正式生效。

sentences.en: The deal was announced by President Biden in a televised address from the White House on Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 该协议由拜登总统周二晚间在白宫发表的电视讲话中宣布。

sentences.en: He said it was designed to end the war between Israel and Hezbollah permanently.
sentences.zh: 他说，该协议旨在永久结束以色列与真主党之间的战争。

sentences.en: It was a major turning point in a conflict that had displaced over a million Lebanese and tens of thousands of Israelis.
sentences.zh: 这是一场冲突中的重大转折点，该冲突已导致超百万黎巴嫩人和数万名以色列人流离失所。

sentences.en: The conflict started on October 7th, when Hezbollah began firing into Israel in solidarity with Hamas.
sentences.zh: 冲突始于10月7日，当时真主党为声援哈马斯开始向以色列开火。

sentences.en: Israel later retaliated, killing the group's longtime leader, planting explosives in the pagers used by the group's operatives,
sentences.zh: 以色列随后进行报复，击毙了该组织长期以来的领导人，在真主党特工使用的寻呼机中安置爆炸物，

sentences.en: and conducting airstrikes against Hezbollah strongholds in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 并对黎巴嫩境内的真主党据点实施了空袭。

sentences.en: The fighting has killed more than 3,000 Lebanese and 100 Israelis, and severely damaged Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 战斗已导致3000多名黎巴嫩人和100名以色列人死亡，并对真主党造成了严重打击。

sentences.en: In the hours before the ceasefire was set to take effect, Israel continued to hit Hezbollah strongholds in Lebanon in the heaviest barrage since the war began.
sentences.zh: 在停火即将生效前的几个小时里，以色列继续打击黎巴嫩境内的真主党据点，发动了战争爆发以来最猛烈的轰炸。

sentences.en: The Lebanese parliament is expected to approve the agreement in a vote on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 预计黎巴嫩议会将在周三的投票中批准该协议。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Muj Zaidy, Jessica Chung, and Luke Vanderplug.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由穆杰·扎伊迪、杰西卡·钟和卢克·范德普鲁格制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 由M.J.编辑

sentences.en: Davis-Linn with help from Chris Haxel, with research assistance by Susan Lee, contains original music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯-林恩在克里斯·哈克尔的协助下完成，苏珊·李提供研究协助，包含丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛萨诺的原创音乐，由阿莉莎·莫克斯利担任音频工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Patrick Kingsley.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢帕特里克·金斯利。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在纽约时报应用程序或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方查找《Wirecutter秀》。
